per_claim_classifications.claim: The apparent formation->touch->fill sign reversal is descriptive across different selected cohorts and is NOT yet a causal stage effect.

The three cohorts differ: FORMATION = all lawful in-window formations (381,498); FIRST_TOUCH = only zones that emit a touch (379,248; 94.0-99.5% of formations); FILL = only zones that fill (379,132). Anchor prices also differ (formation availability tick vs boundary-crossing tick inside/at the zone) and horizon clocks start at different lifecycle moments. The reversal may therefore be cohort selection, anchor-definition mechanics (approach-phase price path into the zone), or drift composition; none is separated. See sign_reversal_classification and the selection audit.

sign_reversal_rationale: The formation-anchored pattern (18 neg / 1 zero / 2 pos) and the touch/fill-anchored patterns (21/21 pos each) are measured on three different cohorts (all lawful formations vs touched-only vs filled-only) with different anchor price definitions (formation availability tick vs in/at-zone boundary tick) and different horizon start points. Touch and fill are outcomes, so the later cohorts are outcome-selected subsamples of the formation cohort; no matched or within-zone evidence exists in E1. The reversal is therefore admitted ONLY as a cross-cohort descriptive pattern. Calling it a stage effect, stage conditioning, approach-phase spending, recentering, or continuation/reversion requires the E2 experiment below. Neither P-03 nor P-04 asserts the stage-effect version without qualification (both register selection and anchor-definition as confounds); no frozen wording converts the cohort pattern into a within-object stage effect, so nothing must be rewritten - the boundary must simply be held at admission.

cohorts.FIRST_TOUCH: only zones with an emitted fvg_first_touch event, N=379,248 (touch incidence 0.9946..0.9401 by stratum)
cohorts.FILL: only zones with a lawful fvg_filled event, N=379,132 (fill incidence 0.9955..0.8443), itself split touched-fill 378,122 / gap-through 1,010

selection_audit.finding: The cohorts are nested by outcome selection (touch and fill are later-bar outcomes of the same zones), and the anchor price changes across stages (formation availability tick vs boundary-crossing tick inside/at the zone). Any difference of stage-level statistics therefore confounds (i) outcome selection, (ii) anchor re-definition, (iii) horizon-clock shift, and (iv) instrument drift interacting with cohort direction composition. E1 contains no matched, within-zone, or time-matched evidence that separates these.
selection_audit.frozen_wording_check: P-03 labels the stage comparison INTERPRETATION and states 'anchor populations are selected (touched/filled zones)' and 'not a tested effect'; P-04 lists cohort conditioning and anchor-price definition among registered confounds and prohibits 'incremental predictive value' language. No frozen text asserts a within-object stage effect. Classification: SURVIVES_AS_DESCRIPTIVE_COHORT_PATTERN. The stage-effect reading is REQUIRES_E2.

recommended_e2_experiment.name: E2 STAGE-MATCHED LIFECYCLE PANEL (recommended; not executed)
design: 1. Within-zone panel: per stratum, for every zone that touches within a pre-registered window, compute direction-adjusted returns at matched calendar offsets from BOTH the formation anchor and the first-touch anchor (and, for zones that fill, the fill anchor). The within-zone touch-vs-formation contrast on identical clock offsets tests stage conditioning while holding the zone, direction, calendar time, and drift exposure fixed.

2. Selection model: censor-aware (single-end administrative) comparison of touched vs never-touched and filled vs touched-unfilled zones on gap_atr, fvg_quality, direction, session/time-of-day, so the population that 'selects into' touch/fill is characterized; selection into touch/fill is thereby measured, not assumed away.

3. Drift-aware null: per stratum and horizon, a time-matched unconditional control (same calendar grid, same direction mix, no FVG requirement) providing the null distribution of direction-adjusted medians under pure window drift; the stage contrast must beat this null to be stage-conditioned.

4. Pre-registered decision rule: stage-conditioned = within-zone sign change that also exceeds the time-matched null; selection-only = the sign change vanishes under matching. Cohorts, denominators, censoring treatment, and the null must be frozen in an E2 contract before any computation. No strategy rules; E3 untouched; confirmation LOCKED.
recommended_e2_experiment.distinguishes: stage-conditioned behavior vs selection into touch/fill vs anchor-definition mechanics vs drift composition

observations: DEVELOPMENT window is upward-drifted: raw median returns positive 21/21 cells at formation, 21/21 at FIRST_TOUCH, 20/21 at FILL (sole negative: 4h FILL h1 -0.145 bps, n=141).

Direction adjustment (sign-of-formation times return) removes the formation-direction component but NOT calendar drift: under upward drift the adjusted statistic is biased positive for bullish zones and negative for bearish zones, and pooling leaves a drift residue proportional to the direction imbalance - and the formation population is descriptively bullish-skewed and increasingly so with scale (bullish share 0.5103 at 15s to 0.6048 at 4h).

The observed asymmetry matches exactly this signature: bullish adjusted medians positive 42/42; bearish mostly zero/negative (FT 5 pos/5 zero/11 neg; FILL 10 pos/1 zero/10 neg). The pooled positive medians are disproportionately bullish-carried and are therefore not distinguishable from drift-carried without controls.

requirements_before_promotion.drift_aware_null: REQUIRED for claims 7, 8, 11 (and any use of the 18/1/2 formation pattern as directional structure): null distribution of direction-adjusted medians under window drift (time-matched unconditional returns per stratum/horizon).
requirements_before_promotion.direction_matched_control: REQUIRED for claims 7, 8, 11, 12: per-direction analysis vs same-direction unconditional windows (bullish-only and bearish-only controls), so the bearish zero/negative pattern can be read separately from pooling.
requirements_before_promotion.time_matched_control: REQUIRED for claims 7, 8, 10, 11: same calendar grid, same stratum, no-FVG control, to separate FVG-specific behavior from calendar/session effects (including session-gap concentration of gap-through fills).

drift_direction_audit.conclusion: All E1 directional patterns are admitted as descriptive only. The raw-return interpretation is drift-contaminated and must not be used; the direction-adjusted interpretation is drift-residual under direction imbalance and equally requires nulls. Bullish/bearish imbalance is itself drift-confounded (E1A X13). Nothing here survives to 'edge' language under any reading.

verified_principles: Observed-event quantiles (conditional on the event having occurred) and administratively censored population quantities are kept distinct in the committed artifacts: E1B carries fill_right_censor_fraction, touch_to_fill_right_censor_fraction, fill_max_identifiable_quantile and touch_to_fill_max_identifiable_quantile per stratum, and the E1A challenge appendix carries max_identifiable_unconditional_quantile = 1 - censor_rate.
fill_rate + right_censored_rate = 1 is an accounting complement, never two findings.
Observed maxima ~10.24e9 ms (~118.5 days) recur across 15s-1h and coincide with the window end: administrative artifacts, not natural lifecycle endpoints.
p95_p99_language_that_must_be_corrected_: Touch->fill p99 at 5m/15m/1h/4h (2,388/1,648/699/175 native bars) is an observed-event (filled-only) quantile; the unconditional p99 is NOT identifiable there (ceilings p98.9/p98.0/p96.2/p89.8). It is identifiable only at 15s/30s/1m.
Formation->fill p99 at 5m/15m/1h/4h (4,654/2,835/1,249/462 bars) is observed-event only (ceilings p97.8/p96.0/p92.2/p84.4).
Formation->fill p95 is unconditionally identifiable through 15m but NOT at 1h/4h (ceilings p92.2/p84.4).

Formation->touch p95 at 4h is NOT identifiable unconditionally: the ceiling is touch incidence p94.01, below 95. The committed 89-bar value is a touched-only quantile. (Subtler than the fill cases; flagged here explicitly.)
All 'max' duration values (~118.5 days) are window-boundary administrative artifacts and must never be described as natural lifetimes.
Any unconditional quantile statement at 4h beyond p84.4 (fill), p89.8 (touch->fill), p94.0 (touch) is prohibited.
censoring_audit.check_of_ceiling_usage: P-03 and P-04 use the fill and touch->fill ceilings correctly and explicitly prohibit unconditional p99 beyond 1m; P-04 additionally marks formation->fill p95 unidentifiable at 1h/4h. No frozen text misquotes an observed-event quantile as unconditional. The formation->touch 4h p95 ceiling case is not spelled out in P-03/P-04 and is recorded here as a required annotation.

same_bar_audit.denominator_check: Verified canonical denominator: same_bar_touch_fill_n / touched_fill_n = 0.3531/0.3541/0.3536/0.3443/0.3419/0.3661/0.4043 (15s..4h), reproduced by E1B_INTERPRETER_FACT_CHECK.json. Alternative denominators (touch anchors or all formations) give 33.5-40.4% - same range, but the frozen artifacts consistently use touched_fill_n and that usage is correct: a same-bar event requires both a touch and a fill, so its natural cohort is touched-and-filled zones.
same_bar_audit.phenotype_or_point_mass: Do not force either interpretation. For: a distinct mode is suggested by the stable ~34-41% share across strata and by p25 = 0 with p50 = 1 at every stratum (the median sits exactly on the boundary between the zero mass and the one-bar mass). Against: the point mass is a geometric near-necessity - touch is range overlap and fill is far-edge reach, so any bar whose range both overlaps a ~0.5-ATR-wide zone and reaches its far edge resolves it same-bar; narrow zones relative to bar range make this common by construction, and no post-fill outcome comparison between same-bar and multi-bar fills exists anywhere in E1 (P-04 QG3 registered, unmeasured). Verdict: the descriptive fact SURVIVES; 'distinct phenotype mode' is INCONCLUSIVE and gated behind QG-candidate G (E2). The point-mass reading is the default until matched evidence says otherwise.

gap_through_audit.counts_verified: E1B_FILL_STRATIFICATION.json: GAP_THROUGH_FILL anchor_n = 682 (15s), 213 (30s), 81 (1m), 20 (5m), 10 (15m), 4 (1h), 0 (4h); total 1,010; touched_fill_total 378,122; fill_anchors_total 379,132. Matches the required confirmation exactly.
gap_through_audit.conclusion_assessment: 'No robust scale-consistent descriptive difference' is justified and correctly bounded: paired comparison is lawful only at 15s (682) and 30s (213) under the predeclared size rule; 15s is a null (sign flips across horizons, |diff| <= 0.105 bps vs IQR ~1.7-5.2 bps); 30s is a single-stratum, small-N, composition-confounded contrast (gap-through medians uniformly higher, but bullish share 55.9% vs 51.1%, ~2.3x wider IQR, contradicted by 15s); 1m (81) already flips sign; 5m/15m/1h/4h are too sparse/empty. The mixture-negligibility check (pooled vs touched-only medians differ <= ~0.002-0.008 bps) confirms gap-through does not drive FILL aggregates.
gap_through_audit.label_discipline: DESCRIPTIVE_ADEQUATE/THIN/TOO_SPARSE/EMPTY are predeclared denominator-based support labels; they are not statistical significance and must never be read as such. The 30s contrast is hypothesis-grade only.

magnitude_audit.method: Compared each direction-adjusted median with its IQR width, p05-p95 span, and N per cell (h1 rows shown; h3/h5 pattern consistent).
claims_reduced_to_weak_central_tendency: Claim 6 (formation 18/1/2 pattern): median magnitudes -0.000..-2.094 bps (and +0.852/+12.508 exceptions) against p05-p95 spans 6.4..561 bps - sign pattern of a weak central tendency; the two positive cells are small-sample medians.
Claim 7 (FIRST_TOUCH 21/21 positive): sign-consistent but medians are 0.15-3.24% of the p05-p95 span at 15s-15m; weak central tendency.
Claim 8 (FILL 21/21 positive): same reduction; additionally raw-vs-adjusted sign divergence at 4h h1 (n=141) shows sign fragility at small N.

Claim 9 (FILL > FIRST_TOUCH 19/21): verified count, but fine-stratum differences are quantile noise (+0.0011 bps at 15m h1 vs IQR ~16.5 bps; +0.0078 bps at 15s h1 vs IQR ~1.7 bps); only 1m-4h h3/h5 differences are descriptively non-trivial.
Claim 11 (bullish-carried): the composition fact is robust, but any per-direction magnitude reading is weak-central-tendency at fine strata and small-N at coarse strata.
Claim 12 (bearish not sign-consistent): verified as a sign census; individual bearish cells are weak medians against wide dispersion.
magnitude_audit.claims_not_reduced: Claims 1, 3, 4, 5 (frequency/count claims on durations and same-bar shares) and the A1/A2 resolution (claims 14, 16) are large-mass, large-N facts, not median-vs-dispersion cases.

surviving_e1_knowledge: 381,498 lawful FVG formations across 7 native XAUUSD strata in the frozen DEVELOPMENT window; deterministic two-run reproduction; integrity gates 9/9 (E1A) and 5/5 (E1B); cross-scale identity prohibited and respected.
Median formation->first-touch = 2 native bars and median first-touch->fill = 1 native bar (p25 = 0) at every stratum; median formation->fill = 7/7/7/7/8/8/5 bars.
34.2-40.4% of touched-and-filled zones fill on the first-touch bar itself (denominator touched_fill_n).

Rapid lifecycle body with a materially long-lived right tail; the observed tail is a censored lower bound, increasingly so at coarse strata (fill censoring 0.45%..15.57%; touch->fill censoring 0.21%..10.19%; unconditional quantiles identifiable only up to the committed per-stratum ceilings).

Direction-adjusted prospective medians: formation anchor 18 negative / 1 zero / 2 positive of 21; FIRST_TOUCH 21/21 positive; FILL 21/21 positive; FILL exceeds FIRST_TOUCH in 19/21 cells - a cross-cohort descriptive pattern, weak central tendency relative to dispersion, NOT a tested effect.
Pooled post-anchor positive tendency is bullish-carried (bullish 42/42 positive; bearish 15/42 positive, mostly zero/negative); bearish medians are not sign-consistent.

Gap-through fills (1,010: 682/213/81/20/10/4/0) are a legitimate producer-semantic case (far-edge fill independent of overlap), never imputed as touch, excluded from FIRST_TOUCH cohorts, and a negligible mixture (<= ~0.008 bps median shift) in FILL aggregates.
Orphan lifecycle events (178 touch / 358 fill) are left-truncated pre-development detector state, correctly excluded from all in-window cohorts.
Observed fill fractions and censoring fractions are accounting complements and window-bounded descriptive quantities, never lifetime probabilities or hazards.
No robust touched-fill vs gap-through post-fill difference is supported at the two paired-eligible strata (15s null; 30s hypothesis-grade contrast).
failed_interpretations: P-04 bearish FILL direction-adjusted sign tally '10 positive / 2 zero / 9 negative' - FAILED mechanical verification (E1B_INTERPRETER_FACT_CHECK.json claims_verified.P04_bearish_fill_10_pos_2_zero_9_neg = false); canonical tally is 10 positive / 1 zero / 10 negative (disputed cell 30s FILL h1 bearish = -2.1e-12 bps); corrected in the P-04 addendum; substantive conclusion unchanged.
Historical (pre-repair, kept as record): P-01 '19/21 negative' direction-adjusted medians - corrected to 18 negative / 1 zero / 2 positive.
Historical: the reconciliation premise 'a filling bar necessarily overlaps the zone' - false under the linked producer implementation; removed from the canonical record.
Historical: P-02 A4 '4h coverage excess' from N-bars x timeframe - METHODOLOGICALLY_UNSUPPORTED_AS_STATED (not a valid observed-coverage estimator).
Historical: '1h has strongest clock dependence' - produced by comparing separate marginal quantiles rather than paired per-event delays; rejected.

Any reading of the stage sign reversal as a within-object stage effect, approach-phase spending, recentering, continuation, reversion, or neutralization - not supported by E1; gated behind E2 (candidate A-C).
Any drift attribution of the bullish-carried pattern (FVG-specific vs window drift) - not separable in E1; gated behind E2 (candidate D).
unresolved_questions: Stage conditioning vs selection into touch/fill (the sign reversal): requires the E2 STAGE-MATCHED LIFECYCLE PANEL; not answerable from E1 by construction.
Whether the post-anchor positive medians are drift residue or FVG-specific: requires drift-aware, direction-matched, time-matched nulls (candidate D).
Whether same-bar fill is a distinct phenotype or a geometric point mass (candidate G).
Whether gap_atr/fvg_quality modify durations or stage response (candidate F), including the floor-pinned gap_atr population question.
Gap-through post-fill behavior beyond the two eligible strata (candidate E).
The lifecycle tail beyond the committed ceilings at 5m-4h is unidentifiable in this window, not observed short.
Whether the monotone bullish formation-share gradient (51.0%..60.5%) is drift, session aggregation, or detector asymmetry (E1A X13).
4h incidence uptick and 4h small-N cells (n=141-167): sampling noise vs genuine coarse-scale structure.
required_e2_questions: E2-Q1 (from A/B): within-zone matched formation-vs-first-touch contrast at identical clock offsets, with a time-matched no-FVG control, per stratum - separates stage conditioning from selection, anchor mechanics, and drift.
E2-Q2 (from D): direction-matched and time-matched drift-aware null for post-touch and post-fill direction-adjusted medians, per direction, per stratum.
E2-Q3 (from C): post-fill vs matched pre-fill control contrast (pre-fill baseline anchor design) to test continuation/neutralization/reversion labels.
E2-Q4 (from E): touched-fill vs gap-through post-fill contrast with composition matching and a pre-registered minimum-N rule (eligible in-window strata: 15s, 30s; 1m marginal).
E2-Q5 (from F/G): censor-aware test of gap_atr and fvg_quality modification of touch->fill duration, and same-bar vs multi-bar post-fill contrast, with floor-selection sensitivity for gap_atr.
All E2 questions require their own frozen measurement contract (cohorts, denominators, nulls, censoring treatment, decision rules) before execution; none may run under E1.
required_e3_questions: E3 (only after E2 adjudication, and only for patterns that survive E2 nulls): out-of-window replication of the stage-contrast and direction-asymmetry results at matched N (e.g., the 1h FILL fvg_quality split separations and the 4h cells), per the frozen confirmation discipline.
E3 must not be entered with any E1 descriptive pattern as a prior 'finding'; confirmation remains LOCKED and no E3 work is authorized by this challenge.
must_not_claim: No edge, alpha, profitability, strategy, signal, or predictive-advantage claims from anything in E1/E1A/E1B; nothing was tested; confirmation LOCKED; E2/E3 NOT STARTED.

The formation->touch->fill sign reversal is NOT a stage effect, NOT approach-phase spending, NOT recentering, NOT continuation/reversion - it is a descriptive pattern across differently selected cohorts with different anchor definitions, until E2 proves otherwise.
No significance, confidence, p-value, or confirmation language anywhere; eligibility labels (DESCRIPTIVE_ADEQUATE/THIN/TOO_SPARSE/EMPTY) are size-support labels, not statistical significance.
Observed fill fractions, touch incidence, and all censoring fractions are window-censored accounting complements, not lifetime probabilities, hazards, or asymptotic fill rates.

No unconditional p99/max at 5m/15m/1h/4h for any duration variable; no unconditional formation->fill p95 at 1h/4h; no unconditional formation->touch p95 at 4h (ceiling p94.0); no unconditional quantile at 4h beyond p84.4 (fill) / p89.8 (touch->fill) / p94.0 (touch).
Observed duration maxima (~118.5 days) are administrative window-boundary artifacts, not natural lifetimes.

The 4h h5 (+12.5 bps formation; +15.7 bps FILL) and 1h h3/h5 cells, the 4h bearish-positive medians (n=63), and the 30s gap-through contrast (n=213) are small-sample medians, not established sign reversals or effects.

Raw-return medians must not be interpreted as directional behavior (window drift); direction-adjusted medians must not be interpreted as drift-free directional structure (drift residue under direction imbalance).
Bearish -0.0 (and -2.1e-12) cells are exact-zero medians (sign-bit/epsilon artifacts), not negative findings.
No cross-scale zone identity, no pooling of strata, no claim that strata are interchangeable; horizons are native-bar-relative (no exposure-matched cross-stratum magnitude comparison).
Development median splits on gap_atr/fvg_quality are not thresholds, cutoffs, or confirmed modifier effects.
Gap-through post-fill behavior is not characterized beyond the 15s null and 30s hypothesis-grade contrast; sparse cells (5m/15m/1h/4h) must never be quoted.
Orphans are not missing formations; A1 gap-through cases are not an anomaly or defect.
Nothing transfers to E2, E3, confirmation, or live use.
